messages.subject: Maersk Thailand | Integrated logistics, decarbonization and stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear Maersk Thailand Leadership Team,

Maersk's integrated logistics platform in Thailand sits at the intersection of trade, infrastructure, customer operations and decarbonization. That is a strong match with the stakeholder and operating environment I manage today.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate coordination, social performance and executive stakeholder strategy at a remote industrial operation where logistics continuity and public-sector coordination are critical.

My recent work also includes stakeholder and governance support around a large solar and battery-storage transition and carbon-data readiness based on physical operational records. I bring the ability to connect commercial and operating priorities with regulators, communities, senior leadership and strategic partners.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand, Southeast Asia or broader regional mandates across External Affairs, Strategic Partnerships, Sustainability, Country Strategy or stakeholder leadership. I have attached a Maersk Thailand-focused executive CV and would appreciate your forwarding it to the relevant senior leadership team.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
